subject: Faro privacy follow-up: DPA request, SCC module guidance & SOC 2 checklist
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@faro.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@faro.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Next steps: DPA request, SCC module guidance & SOC 2 checklist

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone has the same view: we covered Faro's regulatory constraints (EU customer data residency + potential healthcare pilot), the contracting path, and your internal security review timeline.

Key confirmations from the call:
- Faro confirmed you are the data controller for customer data; Redwood will be engaged as a processor for the standard inference API flows. If any service is materially different (e.g., access to raw logs), we'll flag that as a separate controller/processor decision.
- You flagged a potential HIPAA scope for a small pilot — noted, we can treat that as an additional attachment to the DPA and confirm technical controls separately.
- Faro would like a copy of our SOC 2 Type II report and a completed vendor security questionnaire (your VSQ).

Action items (proposed owners & timing):
1) Connor (me) — send Redwood SOC 2 summary + draft DPA for your legal review by EOD tomorrow (Aug 31).
2) Alex / Faro security — share your VSQ spreadsheet; we'll ingest and return with answers / evidence links within 3 business days. (You mentioned an internal VSQ template — please attach.)
3) Neha (Redwood Legal) — start high-level review of SCC module selection given Faro is EU controller; we recommend aiming for the Processor SCC module but will confirm if Controller-to-Controller is needed for any specific data flows.
4) Marissa / Ben (Redwood Product + Security) — I've looped you for any technical clarifications, especially around log retention and encryption-at-rest.

SCC guidance note: from a product+legal standpoint, the common path for customers in Faro's position is to adopt the SCC processor module (Redwood as processor). If you have a strong reason to insist on controller-to-controller language, please flag now so we can route to Legal for redlines — that may impact timelines.

Attachments referenced: Redwood will send a short SOC 2 summary (not the full report) and a DPA draft for redlines.

Proposed next meeting: quick sync next Wed (Sept 2) to walk through the VSQ answers and any DPA redlines. Let me know a 30-min slot that works.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

--
Connor O'Brien
Redwood Inc.
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@faro.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@faro.com>, Faro Security <security@faro.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 13:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps: DPA request, SCC module guidance & SOC 2 checklist

Connor —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the points you captured. A few clarifications from our side:

- Faro acts as the controller for customer data. For our standard product usage we expect Redwood to be the processor. We will call out any exceptions (e.g., bespoke integrations) separately.
- We do need a SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 summary + assertion) to move through central procurement. If you can provide the summary and a pathway to receive the full report under NDA, that would be fine.
- I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (Faro_VSQ.xlsx). Security asked for a 3 business day turn on the questionnaire if possible.

Regarding SCC: our legal prefers the Controller-to-Processor flow, but understands that Module selection can be negotiable. We're happy for Redwood to propose the processor SCC module and we'll confirm after legal reads the DPA.

Attaching: Faro_VSQ.xlsx (see first tab for scoring).

Alex Turner
Head of IT Risk & Compliance
Faro Financial
alex.turner@faro.com
+44 20 7946 0XXX

- DPA: standard Redwood template with options for SCC module selection. We've annotated the SCC section and suggested the Processor module as the default path.
- VSQ: I uploaded Faro_VSQ.xlsx to our intake queue and assigned it to Ben to provide evidence links for the questions flagged as "medium/high". He'll aim to return answers in 48-72 hours.

3) We run the VSQ intake and aim to close the high-risk items before procurement sign-off.

Available for a 30-min call Wed Sept 2 (09:30-11:00 PT) to walk through the VSQ answers and DPA redlines.
